original_value: The authors present a highly complex search-planning problem in which unmanned aerial vehicles and humans collaborate to minimize the expected time at which human rescuers reach a target who is missing. They propose an evolutionary algorithm that uses biogeography-inspired operators to find an optimal or near-optimal solution within an acceptable time.

result.paraphrase: The authors describe a highly complex search-planning problem where unmanned aerial vehicles and humans work together to minimize the expected time for human rescuers to reach a missing target. They present an evolutionary algorithm with biogeography-inspired operators to obtain an optimal or near-optimal solution in acceptable time.
